title: BUILD-014-founder-only-method-brain
universal_lens: The founder-only method brain formalizes a bounded operator $\mathcal{M}$ acting on an open-source leverage Hilbert space. By enforcing strict isolation constraints, the system minimizes entropy leakage into production manifolds, ensuring that internal cognitive state transitions remain mathematically decoupled from external customer-facing observables until explicit boundary conditions are met.
gsi_mapping: Within GSI, this primitive acts as a conformal Bayesian filter over unstructured OSS research. The sandbox environment serves as a prior regularization term, preventing high-variance external data distributions from collapsing the posterior predictive checks of live sportsbook intelligence pipelines before rigorous owner-reviewable validation is achieved.
gse_mapping: For GSE situational reasoning, the method brain defines a discrete state-transition automaton. It enforces a strict topological separation between `docs/research` and `apps/web`, mapping operational SOPs to isolated latent states that only transition to executable app-code upon satisfying explicit approval Hamiltonian thresholds.

primitives.name: Bounded Leverage Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This improves decision quality, revenue, speed, support, retention, trust, or cost savings by converting open-source leverage into a bounded GSE workflow.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Decision Quality (DQ): dimensionless metric; Revenue (R): USD; Speed (S): inverse time [T^-1]; Bounded Workflow (BW): constrained phase space volume.
primitives.assumptions: Open-source leverage can be mapped to a finite-dimensional subspace without introducing infinite variance into the core GSE operating system.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if the bounding constraints fail, causing unbounded coupling between the sandboxed OSS leverage and live production revenue streams.

layer2.mapping: Maps the extraction of value from external repositories directly to a constrained optimization problem within the GSE operating manifold.
layer2.telemetry: Measured via reduction in manual coordination hours and latency in SOP generation.

primitives.name: Production Isolation Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: Start in docs or a sandbox and only move into app code after explicit approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Sandbox State ($\Sigma_s$): isolated logical partition; App Code State ($\Sigma_a$): production execution space; Approval Gate ($\mathcal{G}$): binary boolean threshold.
primitives.assumptions: A hard topological boundary exists between documentation/sandbox environments and the compiled application runtime.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Boundary violation occurs if implicit dependencies allow sandbox artifacts to mutate production state variables without passing through $\mathcal{G}$.

layer2.mapping: Derives a strict gating kernel for GSE state transitions, ensuring no unauthorized writes to `apps/web/app/api/`.
layer2.telemetry: Zero unauthorized commits to production directories; successful rollback capability verification.

primitives.name: Security Null-Space Projection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Security Boundary No secrets, production data, customer PII, proprietary method docs, payment data, or production source keys.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Secrets ($\mathcal{K}$): cryptographic strings; PII ($\mathcal{P}$): protected identity vectors; Null Space ($\mathcal{N}$): zero-information subspace.
primitives.assumptions: The sandbox environment must act as a perfect sink for sensitive data projections, retaining zero information about production secrets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Leakage regime where non-zero norms of PII or cryptographic keys are detected within the isolated lab environment.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a strict projection operator in GSE that forces all sensitive production tensors to zero within the research sandbox.
layer2.telemetry: Absence of `.env*` files, Stripe keys, or PII in the generated implementation packet.

The Method Brain acts as a rational intermediary, anticipating the founder's desire for speed while strictly enforcing the risk agent's boundary conditions. It predicts that without explicit, documented approval gates, the probability of accidental production contamination approaches unity, thereby necessitating a rigid, stepwise epistemic protocol.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by vetoing any state transition where the sandbox artifact exhibits non-zero correlation with production secret vectors.
